title: Moderation: optional, AI first, human override
description:
Moderation of public content (submissions, comments, ratings) is supported and optional, per publication. Decision (2026-10-21): content is public immediately, and Papyrus must support optional human moderation: a queue, approve, hide and ban actions, and rules. Plan: build and test human moderation, then switch human moderation off per publication once AI moderation is trusted (decisions align). Default goal: AI moderation with human override.

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestone 7). Applies to: public submit-a-link and comments epics (siblings). Language-model tasks default to the cheap GPT-6 Luna tier unless stated otherwise. Humanus checks on submissions are an input signal.

Children: per-publication moderation setting; moderation queue in Administration; report control; moderation rules; AI moderation with human override; trust graduation (turning human moderation off).
Definition of Done: a pilot publication can run in each mode (off, human, AI with override) and switch between them by setting.
